findings.finding: Some real estate agents may face situations where they do not get paid for their work.
findings.qualification: This evidence is self-reported from a YouTube transcript and has not been independently verified.

findings.finding: Closing a deal quickly can potentially expedite an agent's payment process.
findings.qualification: This insight is based on observed behavior mentioned in a YouTube transcript and is unverified.

findings.finding: Real estate agents are advised to have a varied wardrobe, specifically at least one suit per day, totaling at least five suits, to maintain a professional appearance.
findings.qualification: This recommendation is part of advised content from a YouTube video and is not independently confirmed.

findings.finding: Smaller, focused teams within boutique agencies might lead to better performance results.
findings.qualification: This claim is observed in a YouTube transcript and lacks verification from other sources.
